verdict: Ready to merge and deploy with CM5 verification

findings.title: Concrete access variants lacked coverage
findings.why_it_matters: A generic predicate assertion did not document that notify open and close events from Indexer reads are the production feedback-loop trigger.
evidence: The Linux notify backend maps watched file opens to AccessKind::Open.
The test now covers open, read close, write close, and access-time metadata while retaining positive mutation cases.
findings.resolution: Expanded the watcher predicate test and reran targeted and full gates.

advisory_outputs.note: CM5 must prove queue drainage plus stable Indexer CPU and thread counts after deployment.
